response.sql: WITH linked_fees AS (SELECT o.orderbase, f.feerate FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate IS NOT NULL), channel_rates AS (SELECT orderbase, AVG(feerate) AS avg_fee_rate FROM linked_fees WHERE orderbase IS NOT NULL GROUP BY orderbase), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(feerate) AS avg_fee_rate FROM linked_fees) SELECT AVG(c.avg_fee_rate) AS mean_average_fee_rate, AVG(c.avg_fee_rate - b.avg_fee_rate) AS mean_amount_above_average FROM channel_rates AS c CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE c.avg_fee_rate > b.avg_fee_rate

assumptions.assumption: The overall average gives each linked fee record equal weight, including records whose order channel is missing.

alternatives.interpretation: The overall average gives each known order channel equal weight.
